changelog: ✦ Kompas Makro Institusional Real-Time: Engine DXY, US 10Y Yield, VIX, SMT XAU/XAG, SVG Gauge, & guard rilis aktual USD.
✦ Candle Replay Pro Studio: Potong Bar interaktif, scrubber timeline, 5 tipe chart, skala %/Log/Auto, indikator anti-bocor (EMA/VWAP/BB/Sesi), magnet OHLC, & 1-klik order.
✦ Beranda Command Center Strip & Lot Sync Profil: Ringkasan Saldo Aktif, Sesi & News Guard, Kompas XAU live, serta Kalkulator Lot tersinkron Profil + breakdown performa POI.
✦ AMY Assistant 30-Detik Briefing & Jurnal Playbook Scorecard: Chip 'Layak Entry?', rapor Grade A–D per setup ICT, performa harian WITA, & Detektor Kebocoran Otomatis.
✦ Backend Multi-Key + Cadangan Lengkap: Rotasi multi-key TwelveData, stale fallback cache 30m, dan ekspor/pulihkan cadangan profil menyertakan Riwayat POI & Alarm.
